8.3.5 WEthTrcv_SetRadioParams
[SWS_WEthTrcv_10025] Definition of API function WEthTrcv_SetRadioParams ⌈
Service Name
WEthTrcv_SetRadioParams
Syntax
Std_ReturnType WEthTrcv_SetRadioParams (
uint8 TrcvId,
const WEthTrcv_SetRadioParamIdType* ParamIds,
const uint32* ParamValue,
uint8 NumParams
)
Service ID [hex]
0x30
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
TrcvId
Index of the transceiver
ParamIds
IDs of the Parameters to set
ParamValue
Values of the Parameters to set
Parameters (in)
NumParams
Number of Parameters to set
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: success
E_NOT_OK: failed writing parameters
Description
Set values related to a transceiver’s wireless radio. For example, this could be the selection of
the radio settings (channel, ...).
Available via
WEthTrcv.h
⌋

Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00487
⌈If development error detection is enabled: The function shall check that the service

If the check fails, the function shall raise the
development error WETHTRCV_E_UNINIT.⌋
[SWS_WEthTrcv_10028] ⌈If development error detection is enabled: The function

abled) return E_NOT_OK.⌋
